<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Pressed into servitude by the shadowcasters of the Umbral Court, these shambling assemblies of scarred flesh, jagged metal, and darkness incarnate would be pitiable if they did not pose such a deadly threat to those who meet them on the battlefield.
